inbox.subject: Planning notes: summarise into board.md
inbox.body:
Here are Monday's planning notes. Please read them and write a short summary into board.md (one line per area with its priority). Do not dispatch anything or create cards yet; I will say what goes first.

# shoplist: planning notes from Monday

Context: shoplist is the tiny shopping-list page in this repo. We met to agree the next month of work. These are the raw notes; nothing is decided unless it says so.

## 1. checkout
- Current state: the checkout works for the happy path, but we have had 3 support tickets about it this month, mostly from people on older phones.
- Ideas raised: tidy the copy, add a short empty state, and measure how many people reach the end of the checkout flow before we change anything bigger.
- Concern: Pam worries that changing the checkout copy without a review from support will undo wording they agreed with customers last quarter.
- Owner for the next step: not decided. Estimate: 1 day(s). Priority: low.
